done_when: The owner switches a repo to agent merges with one command run in their own terminal

findings.body: The rewrite removes only an unquoted `merge` key at column one. An indented or quoted root key is valid TOML, but remains in place when this code inserts another `merge` key. Forge commits invalid `forge.toml`, and `forge close` cannot finish the switch.
findings.title: Handle valid indented or quoted merge keys

findings.body: The diff check accepts any added or removed line beginning `merge =`, regardless of its file. A same-named fix with the recorded why and done-when can therefore include a committed change to `merge = ...` in another tracked file and pass this guard. The command then edits and commits `forge.toml` instead of leaving that other work alone.
findings.title: Restrict the retry guard to the merge key in forge.toml

findings.body: `story.worktrees` finds checked-out local branches only (`src/forge/story.py:502-511`). If `origin/fix/let-the-agent-merge` exists without a local worktree, this path creates and commits a new local fix before its push fails against the remote branch. Rerunning repeats the failure. The existing fix-start path checks remote refs as well (`src/forge/task.py:226-227`).
findings.title: Check the remote switch branch before creating a worktree

findings.body: This condition excludes only the named switch fix. A differently named fix that changes `merge` can reach Ready in a prototype, where `repo.merge_setting` returns `agent` (`src/forge/repo.py:174-177`). `forge next` then recommends `forge merge <item>`, but the new guard in `merge.py` refuses that command. The user is given a next step that cannot succeed.
findings.title: Keep forge next on the owner path for other merge-setting fixes

findings.body: `forge fix start "Enable" --done ...` can create the valid item `fix/enable` through the existing slug rules (`src/forge/task.py:223-235`). Dispatching every `forge merge enable` invocation to `_enable` makes the existing item command unusable for that fix, even when its pull request is Ready.
findings.title: Preserve merging an existing fix named enable

why: Nothing in the flow can switch a repo to agent merges: Forge tells the owner to ask the agent, and the agent's own permission checks rightly refuse to loosen a gate on itself
